# Generic "must never be committed" patterns (POSIX ERE, one per line; '#' = comment).
# Deliberately broad and platform-agnostic: covers mainstream cloud, VCS, AI, SaaS,
# payment, messaging, registry, and key formats without identifying any specific provider in use.

# Private keys & certificates with embedded private material
-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |DSA |OPENSSH |PGP |ENCRYPTED )?PRIVATE KEY-----

# Cloud providers (AWS, GCP/Google, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Azure, DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, etc.)
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])(AKIA|ASIA|AIDA|AROA)[0-9A-Z]{16}([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])LTAI[0-9A-Za-z]{12,24}([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])AKID[0-9A-Za-z]{20,40}([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])(CLOUDFLARE|CF|AWS|AZURE|GCP|ALIYUN|ALIBABA|TENCENT|HUAWEI|VOLC|DO|DIGITALOCEAN|VERCEL|NETLIFY|FLY|RAILWAY)_(API_TOKEN|ACCESS_KEY|SECRET_KEY|SECRET_ACCESS_KEY|ACCOUNT_ID|ZONE_ID|CLIENT_SECRET)[ ]*[:=][ ]*["']?[A-Za-z0-9_./+=-]{20,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])dop_v1_[0-9a-f]{64}([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=[^;[:space:]]+;AccountKey=[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}

# Version control & CI platforms (GitHub, GitLab)
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])glpat-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}

# AI / LLM & ML platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Groq, xAI, Replicate, Perplexity)
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])sk-(proj-|ant-api[0-9]+-|or-v1-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])gsk_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])xai-[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])r8_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])pplx-[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}

# Messaging, SaaS, payments & package registries (Slack, Stripe, SendGrid, npm, PyPI, crates.io)
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])(sk|rk)_(live|test)_[0-9A-Za-z]{20,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])SG\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])npm_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])pypi-AgEI[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}
(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])cio[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}

# Local home/secret directory paths
(/home/[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*/|/Users/[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]*/)(secrets|\.ssh|\.config|\.aws|\.kube|\.gnupg|Desktop|Documents|Downloads|Library)
[A-Za-z]:\\Users\\[^\\[:space:]]+
